class.name: OcgTopodsWire
class.brief_description: Describes a wire which - references an underlying wire with the potential to be given a location and an orientation - has a location for the underlying wire, giving its placement in the local coordinate system - has an orientation for the underlying wire, in terms of its geometry (as opposed to orientation in relation to other shapes).
